note: IremboGov's guide to a first e-passport application, modified 11 February 2026; it writes the youngest band as '15 years and below'. A replacement's fees, and whether there is an urgent service, are leads.

sources.title: IremboGov support (support.irembo.gov.rw), Tips and how to apply for an E-Passport for the first time
sources.said: Modified on: Wed, 11 Feb, 2026 at 6:31 PM ... This applies to someone who is applying for a passport for the first time or replacing or renewing a passport that was issued by DGIE before 28 June 2019. ... Applicant: 16 and 17 years 5 years 25,000 ... Applicant: 15 years and below 2 years 25,000 ... Applicant: 18 and above Passport Type Passport Validity Fees (Rwf) Attachments Service 5 years 15,000 Copy of National ID Passport Photo Signature A recommendation letter issued by a government institution Ordinary 10 years 100,000 ... The application process takes 4 working days from the date of submission to the day you receive your passport
